stages.intent: Restore conservatively without sacrificing intentional low notes, attacks or distortion
Inspect post-restoration click and tempo candidates; retain half/double ambiguity
Measure mixture tone including intentional low register
Inspect experimental pitch candidates; tonic, mode and intended notes may remain unknown
Suggest phrase boundaries and recurrences with nullable tonal and rhythm context
Record review spans and compare observed attacks against explicitly approved rhythm/phrase annotations
Present artifact lineage, review flags and listening boundaries

parallel_diagnostics.intent: Keep raw metronome evidence available when restoration alters clicks

execution_policy: Registry declares intended dependencies; dag.py verifies existing artifacts and never runs DSP or downloads models. Raw-source artifacts are explicitly preliminary.
